purpose: Teach: オマケ/脳みそ/右肩/負け犬/ペースト/方角/かわし/ひきこもり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お菓子のオマケ集めてたな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you collecting those little toy prizes from snack boxes?
lines.style: Teasing, knowing smirk. Light and quick — she's caught him in something harmless. Playful edge, not mean.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、脳みそが疲れてるな、桜
lines.en: You're the one whose brain checked out, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick comeback, deadpan. Matches her energy exactly — not defensive, just turning it back on her. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、右肩怪我してたな
lines.en: Riku, didn't you have that injury on your right shoulder?
lines.style: Shift to genuine curiosity — softer than the teasing. Noticing something she cares about. Slight lean in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、負け犬気分にならないでくれ、桜
lines.en: Don't go feeling sorry for yourself about it, Sakura.
lines.style: Firmer here — a quiet defense of himself wrapped in concern for her. Not lecturing. Steady, almost gentle push back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、わさびペーストが苦手だったな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you terrible with wasabi paste?
lines.style: Back to teasing — brighter now, lighter jab. She's circling back to the easier stuff, not pushing the wound.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、方角音痴だったな、桜
lines.en: Oh please, you couldn't find your way out of a parking lot, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry comeback delivered with rhythm. Relaxed now — they're settling into the familiar back-and-forth. Barely suppressed laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカーで相手をかわしてゴール決めたな
lines.en: Riku, you pulled off that amazing goal in soccer — really weaved past the defense.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through. Warm, sincere. She's showing him she remembers the good things too. No irony here.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みひきこもりっぱなしだったろ、桜
lines.en: And you basically lived in your room all summer, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, almost conspiratorial — not accusatory. Wry observation with affection underneath. Knows why he did it, doesn't press.
